    commitment_ledger = [

        {"source": "C1", "destination": "C1", "volume": 40, "channel": 1},
        {"source": "D1", "destination": "D1", "volume": 40, "channel": 1},
    ]

    TIP_MAX_VOLUME_UL = 50  # tip_rack_50ul capacity

    executed_operations = []
    discrepancies = []

    try:
        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # 3. Pre-flight validation (tip overflow / bad volumes)
        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        for entry in commitment_ledger:
            if entry["volume"] > TIP_MAX_VOLUME_UL:

                    f"Ledger volume {entry['volume']} uL exceeds tip capacity "
                    f"({TIP_MAX_VOLUME_UL} uL) for entry {entry}"
                )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        for idx, entry in enumerate(commitment_ledger):
            src_well = source_plate[entry["source"]]
            dst_well = destination_plate[entry["destination"]]
            tip_pos = tip_rack[f"A{idx + 1}"]  # fresh tip per transfer

            # Always pick up tips before aspirating
            await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_pos)

            # Aspirate from the source well

            # Dispense into the destination well

            # Always drop tips after dispensing
            await lh.drop_tips(tip_pos)

                "source": entry["source"],
                "destination": entry["destination"],
                "volume": entry["volume"],
